The '''Kiax Nebula''' was located in [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]]. It was the twin nebula of [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]] in [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]]. It was named after the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] god [[Kiax (god)|Kiax]].
